tagline: Global leader in branded consumer packaged goods of superior quality and value
hero_kpi_rationale: Master indicator for the Consumer Staples sector measuring pure organic growth excluding foreign exchange impact and M&A, key to assessing real demand dynamics and the ability to increase prices and volumes across its global brands.

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth excluding foreign exchange impacts and acquisitions or divestitures.
kpis.description: Organic sales growth is P&G's primary performance metric, reflecting the ability to increase prices and volumes across its global brands.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth despite an inflationary environment.

kpis.name: Volume Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in units sold, excluding price and foreign exchange effects.
kpis.description: Volume reflects physical consumer demand, a key indicator to distinguish inflation-driven growth from usage-driven growth.
kpis.signal: Real volume growth, indicating healthy underlying demand.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin excluding non-recurring items, measuring cost efficiency.
kpis.description: Adjusted operating margin shows P&G's ability to maintain profitability despite cost pressures.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement driven by productivity and premium product mix.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Cash generated after operating and investing expenses.
kpis.description: FCF is stable and high, enabling P&G to maintain an attractive shareholder return profile.
kpis.signal: High FCF supporting dividends and share repurchases.

kpis.name: R&D Spending as % of Sales
kpis.explanation: Portion of sales invested in research and development.
kpis.description: P&G maintains a consistent level of R&D to fuel its innovation pipeline and strengthen its brands.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical assets to maintain or expand operations.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures are focused on supply chain optimization and digital capabilities.
kpis.signal: Moderate Capex, focused on efficiency and digitalization.

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth excluding foreign exchange impacts and acquisitions or divestitures.
kpis.description: P&G has strengthened its premium mix and pricing strategy, driving organic growth to 5% in 2025.

kpis.name: Volume Growth
kpis.explanation: Change in units sold, excluding price and foreign exchange effects.
kpis.description: After years of volume pressure, P&G is regaining physical growth supported by new products and emerging markets.
kpis.signal: Volume recovery following a period of contraction.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Rate Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in approximately 70 countries and foreign exchange rate fluctuations can reduce the value of its sales and earnings.

risks.title: Uncertain Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Uncertain economic conditions may reduce market growth rates and impact demand for the company's products.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions and variability in trade relationships can disrupt company operations and affect tariffs and trade flows.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions due to external factors can impact production and delivery capacity.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Competition from local and global brands, as well as retailer private labels, may reduce market share and margins.

risks.title: Reputational Risks
risks.score_rationale: Concerns regarding product safety, quality, ingredients, efficacy, packaging content, or supply chain practices may affect consumer trust.

risks.title: Cost Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in raw material prices, labor, transportation, and energy costs may affect profit margins.

ai_positioning.summary: P&G does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
